definition_text: Missed-crosswalk check (#285). There are no detections on this page. For each panorama: click the centre of every marked crosswalk you can see (painted, brick or paver all count). If there are none, press m. Click a mark again to flag it unsure, and once more to remove it. Mark what you can recognise as a crosswalk without zooming all the way in; do not hunt for specks at the horizon. Please note the time after the first 10 panoramas.

definition_text: Crosswalk means a marked pedestrian crossing across a roadway: painted markings (zebra bars or two parallel lines, on any road surface, cobblestone included) or a brick, paver, stamped or coloured band laid across the road as a crossing, with or without white edge lines (Jon, 2026-11-08). A cobblestone or brick road, plaza or sidewalk with no crossing band is not a crosswalk.
